BROCK pulled the filings; WALTER independently re-checked the load-bearing NEGATIVE by enumerating every 8-K item code CRMT (CIK 0000799850) has filed. There is NO Item 2.04 — which is the exact artifact -019's OWN BODY pre-registered as the expected default filing — and the 6/25/26 8-K files under ITEM 1.01 "Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement," corroborating POSITIVELY rather than only by absence.

#   🔑 THE STRUCTURAL FINDING, AND IT IS THE REASON THIS SWEEP WAS WORTH RUNNING: THE CORRECTION LINK IS ONE-DIRECTIONAL.

#     SIG-W-20260728-001 carries a machine-readable `corrects: SIG-W-20260723-003, SIG-W-20260727-019` field. Nothing pointed BACK. A reader arriving at -019 — from the INDEX, from a grep, from a cluster scan — had no way to learn it had been corrected the following day. The pointer exists in the direction the AUTHOR travels and is absent in the direction READERS travel.

#     ⇒ Same shape as the retirement gap found earlier the same session (SIG-W-20260803-002): a link that exists one way and is missing the way it is actually used. In both cases the surface reads healthy because nothing errors and nothing disagrees.

#     ⇒ CANDIDATE MECHANIZATION, SURFACED NOT BUILT: a walter_doctor check that reads every `corrects:` field on the BOARD and fails loud when a named target lacks a `status:` tag. It is a one-pass grep over files already parsed by board_reconcile, and it would have caught both of these on 7/28. Recorded here so it is not re-discovered.

A 7/2 scorecard whose headline reads "institutional 0/4, STALLED and partially REVERSED" is no longer merely a dated snapshot: ITS HEADLINE NUMBER NOW POINTS THE OPPOSITE WAY TO THE LIVE STATE. That is the one condition the blanket anchor-pointer backstop does NOT cover — the backstop tells a reader to check the anchor, but a reader who sees "0/4 STALLED" and does not feel any tension has no reason to.

# ===================== 🔴 AMENDMENT (same session, ~10 min later) — I RAN THE PROPOSED CHECK INSTEAD OF CARRYING IT, AND IT INVERTED THE PROPOSAL =====================

# Carry item 1 above proposed a walter_doctor check: "read every `corrects:` field on the BOARD and fail loud when a named target lacks a `status:` tag." Rather than defer it, I ran it as a one-off over all 662 signals. The result did not say what I expected.
#   FULL-BOARD SCAN RESULT: 0 corrected-but-untagged signals remaining. But the reason is NOT that the BOARD is clean —
#   🔴 **EXACTLY ONE SIGNAL ON THE ENTIRE BOARD USES THE `corrects:` FIELD.** (SIG-W-20260728-001, the CRMT correction.)

#   ⇒ **ADOPTION IS 1 OF 9 (11%).** Corrections on this desk are overwhelmingly expressed as PROSE correction blocks, not as a machine-readable link. My own SIG-W-20260803-002, written earlier TODAY, is one of the eight that does not carry the field.

#   🔑 THEREFORE THE CHECK I PROPOSED WOULD HAVE BEEN WORSE THAN NO CHECK. It would have inspected 11% of corrections, found nothing wrong in that 11%, and REPORTED CLEAN — permanently — while the other 89% of corrections went on being unlinked. That is the silent-false-all-clear failure direction recorded in `[[finding_test_the_guard_not_just_the_guarded]]`: a guard that goes quiet and looks healthy is strictly worse than the gap it was built for, because the gap at least stays visible.
#   **The problem is NOT a detection gap. It is an ADOPTION gap, and no amount of checking the field fixes a field nobody fills in.**

#   ⇒ REVISED MECHANIZATION (a PROPOSAL TO WILL, not built — this is a header-schema change and CLAUDE.md RULE 8 routes schema changes to SIGNAL_FORMAT_SPEC.md with structural changes flagged to Will first):

#     make `corrects:` REQUIRED when `signal_type: correction`, and have the doctor key off `signal_type` — a field with 9/9 reliable usage — rather than off `corrects:`, which is the field being skipped. A check must key on something the author RELIABLY writes, never on the thing they are forgetting to write.
#     Retro-fill cost is small and bounded: 8 signals, each of which already names its target in prose.
#   🔑 AND THE GENERALISATION, which is the durable part and applies well beyond this field:

#     **DO NOT KEY A COMPLETENESS CHECK ON THE FIELD WHOSE ABSENCE IS THE DEFECT.** The check must key on an independently-reliable marker that implies the field is owed. Keying on the missing thing means the check's coverage is exactly the set of cases that are already fine — it is definitionally blind to every instance it exists to catch, and its silence is indistinguishable from health.

#     This is the third instance this session of one structural shape: a link or guard that exists in the direction the author travels and is absent in the direction it is actually needed (the retired-threshold gap in SIG-W-20260803-002; the one-directional `corrects:` pointer above; and now the check that would have keyed on the absent field). Recorded together because the shape, not any one instance, is the finding.
